body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. just Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene when a DBH test is needed) + build a fresh column via the dev action "AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated — test on a freshly generated column instead. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through** (RimWorld input is welded to Find.CurrentMap). Shared pattern (pass 33): ONE render-aware hit-test (`BelowSelection.SelectablesUnderMouse` / `TryBelowRightClickCell`) + ONE input-scope adapter (`ABCurrentMapSwap` — point CurrentMap at the lower map around a read/action; plumb transform => same screen cell). Selection (in-place, no jump) + orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics; multi-frame drags are the hard part.
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33):** "switch the view to that level to build/order" is acceptable. Do NOT build cross-level designators/zones/plans.
- Logistics doctrine (pass 32): every ferry MONOTONE (storage=vanilla+capacity clamp; demand=shortfall+retention via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger). Needs-bridge: postfix vanilla giver, re-run guard chain, probe linked levels, one-hop stairs job, per-pawn cooldowns. Work-migration hysteresis: post-arrival commitment cooldown, arrival-tick recharge, bumps only for level-linked maps.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7, postmortem pass 16). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12, revisit dossier pass 22).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB.

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY

## Fixes/features BUILT (green), NOT yet user-verified
1. **RMB building hit-test** (root-caused via [AB RMB diag]: ResolveTargetMap chose target level from RAW clicked cell's open-air terrain, so a below building the cursor rounded off never redirected). `BelowSelection.TryBelowRightClickCell` = render-aware hit-test; RMB prefix snaps clickPos onto that below cell before ShouldRedirect. Generic (DBH via vanilla FloatMenuOptionProvider_FromThing + WrapOptions, NO per-mod patch). Only refines when the cheap test would NOT already resolve below.
2. **Elevation-lock GroundMap hardening:** GroundMap() now walks vertical links when the groundMap field is null (bounded by 3-level cap), so ShouldSuppressJump can't fail open. Hardens SameColumn + 2-hop RMB too.
3. **Cross-level DRAG-BOX select** (`Patch_Selector_SelectInsideDragBox_Below`): below candidates via CurrentMap-swap + vanilla ThingSelectionUtility scan filtered VisibleFromAbove; vanilla category priority over COMBINED sky+below pool; sky via Select, below via AddInPlace (sky-first so dedup never wipes below). Only takes over when box covers a visible below thing. Mixed sky+below intended.
4. **Targeter WIDENING** (`CrossLevelTargeting.TryHandleActionTargeter`): action-only tool targeters (DBH connect-fixture-to-bed, cell pickers, modded, NO drafted attackers) resolve a below thing/cell via the targeter's own targetParams+validator and fire the action (no routing), CurrentMap pointed at the target level. Melee-squad action path unaffected (discriminated by "no drafted pawns").
5. **Hover MOUSEOVER READOUT** (`Patch_MouseoverReadout_Below`): over a see-through cell, point CurrentMap at the lower map for the readout draw so the bottom-left panel reports the below thing/terrain. (Interpreted "hover thing tooltip" = mouseover readout; always-on floating labels over below things = separate render add, NOT built — offer if user meant that.)
6. **TEMP dev diagnostics still in build:** [AB RMB diag] + [AB lock diag], Prefs.DevMode-gated. STRIP after items 1-2 user-verified.

## Test-run status
#147: confirmed RMB raw-cell bug via diag; lock not exercised. #150 (full modlist): ABORTED APPROACH — user forbade full-modlist launches (see TESTING RULE). Neither the pass-33 features nor the item-1/2 fixes are user-verified yet.

## INTERACTION AUDIT (vanilla mouse/UI x see-below) — pass 33
✅ done · ⚠️ partial · ❌ out of scope
- Select: single/double/shift left-click ✅; **drag-box ✅ (p33, untested)**; bracket ✅; inspect+gizmos of below-selected ✅.
- Info: **mouseover readout ✅ (p33, untested, hover)**; always-on floating labels over below ❌ not built.
- RMB orders: single/multi/building(generic)/attack/formation-drag/stairs ✅ (**building hit-test p33, untested**).
- Targeters: melee/ranged/ability/turret/hover-cursor ✅; **action-only tool targeters ✅ (p33 widening, untested)**.
- Designators: ❌ OUT OF SCOPE per user; workaround = switch view.
- Camera: level view switch ✅; colonist-bar/alerts/letters jump ✅ (**lock GroundMap hardened p33, untested**).

## OPTIONAL future (proposed, not committed)
Unify hit-test into one BelowInput.Resolve() (kills the drift bug class that caused #1). Always-on floating below-thing labels. Targeter hover-cursor validity for action targeters over below.

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (P0-P3 done passes 27-30; P4 verify-only backlog stands). COMPAT BUILT pass 31: WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement diagnostic · light diagnostic · RMB diagnostic · below-things regen tallies.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + companion DBH + dev-built column)
**0-pre (PASS 33, TOP): (a) RMB a DBH well/any building from the sky -> options appear + pawn routes down. (b) End-lock ON + click a colonist on another level in the VANILLA bar -> view stays. (c) drag a select box over the surface from the sky -> below things select in place; mixed sky+below box selects both. (d) DBH connect-fixture-to-bed (or any tool targeter) aimed at a below bed -> connects. (e) hover a below building through open air -> bottom-left readout shows IT.** Then strip [AB RMB diag]/[AB lock diag].
Pass-32 queue still pending: log-carousel dead, stair-thrash dead, ferry round-2, pass-31 compat session, below lighting, animal flow, BAM/Batch B/C, perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing, P4 sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
